Entries.Title: The Apothecary Diaries
Entries.Description: Maomao lived a peaceful life with her apothecary father. Until one day, she's sold as a lowly servant to the emperor's palace. But she wasn't meant for a compliant life among royalty. So when imperial heirs fall ill, she decides to step in and find a cure! This catches the eye of Jinshi, a handsome palace official who promotes her. Now, she's making a name for herself solving medical mysteries!

Episodes.Title: Maomao
Episodes.Description: After being kidnapped and forced to work as a servant in the rear palace, former apothecary Maomao inadvertently draws the attention of the higher ranks when she investigates what's causing the emperor's infant heirs to fall mysteriously ill.

Episodes.Title: Chilly Apothecary
Episodes.Description: Maomao tries to settle into her promotion to lady-in-waiting and food taster, but struggles to fend off both boredom and the overly-familiar Jinshi. That is, until she gets an assignment of her dreams: to concoct an aphrodisiac.

Episodes.Title: The Unsettling Matter of the Spirit
Episodes.Description: Tasked with investigating a ghostly woman dancing nightly on the palace walls, Maomao finds a sleepwalking Concubine Fuyou. But with no medicinal cure for sleepwalking, she's forced to dig deeper to find the real reason behind Fuyou's affliction.

Episodes.Title: The Threat
Episodes.Description: Under direct orders from the emperor himself, Maomao tries to care for an ailing Concubine Lihua, but finds her work impeded by Lihua's own ladies-in-waiting.

Episodes.Title: Covert Operations
Episodes.Description: A eunuch stricken by a curse comes begging for aid. Meanwhile, the rear palace buzzes with excitement as everyone prepares for the upcoming garden party, and Gyokuyou's ladies-in-waiting aren't about to let Maomao get away without dressing her up.

Episodes.Title: The Garden Party
Episodes.Description: Maomao does her best to navigate the complex social situations at the garden party, including meeting the other Upper First rank concubines. But once she settles down to do her work as a food-taster, she discovers a surprise in a bowl of soup.

Episodes.Title: Homecoming
Episodes.Description: Gaoshun goes to Maomao to get her help in resolving the events of the garden party. Later, Xiaolan explains the purpose of the hairpins Maomao was gifted, and Maomao makes a deal with Lihaku in order to finally visit home.

Episodes.Title: Wheat Stalks
Episodes.Description: Maomao's peaceful morning at home is interrupted when she's called in to investigate an apparent double suicide at one of the local brothels.

Episodes.Title: Suicide or Murder?
Episodes.Description: An older acquaintance of Jinshi's dies while drinking at a party. A servant's body turns up in a moat. Both deaths are written off as self-inflicted, but Maomao's keen observations tell her that there's more to both stories.

Episodes.Title: Honey
Episodes.Description: A tea party hosted by Lady Gyokuyou puts the politics of the rear palace at the forefront, and Maomao learns something new about Lady Lishu. His true intentions unclear, Jinshi sends Maomao to work for Lady Ah-Duo.

Episodes.Title: Reducing Two to One
Episodes.Description: Maomao confronts Fengming about the dark secret she's been hiding from her noble Lady Ah-Duo.

Episodes.Title: The Eunuch and the Courtesan
Episodes.Description: Discovering that Maomao's kidnappers were connected to Fengming's family, Jinshi is faced with a choice between keeping Maomao in the rear palace where he can be near her or releasing her from her service.

Episodes.Title: Serving in the Outer Court
Episodes.Description: To Maomao's surprise, Jinshi brings her directly to his house instead of taking her back to the rear palace, and tells her she's to work in the outer court. Not only is there much to learn, it seems there's many eyes on her as the new hire.

Episodes.Title: The New Pure Consort
Episodes.Description: Ah-Duo's replacement has arrived in the rear palace, and Maomao is assigned to give a certain lecture to all four high concubines. Later, Maomao helps Lihaku investigate a warehouse explosion.

Episodes.Title: Raw Fish
Episodes.Description: Gaoshun requests Maomao's help in solving an apparent poisoning case. Meanwhile, Jinshi deals with an unwelcome visitor who's taken to lingering in his office.

Episodes.Title: Lead
Episodes.Description: A shack, a chest of drawers, and a fishbowl are all that a talented metalworker leaves to his three sons upon his death. Maomao is assigned to investigate how these strange inheritances all fit together.

Episodes.Title: A Jaunt Around Town
Episodes.Description: Covering up Jinshi's otherworldly beauty is no easy task, but after Maomao takes the challenge head-on, she's surprised when she's also asked to don the disguise of a noblewoman and escort "Jinka" outside the palace.

Episodes.Title: Lakan
Episodes.Description: Back at home, Maomao visits an annex building at the Verdigris House that hides one of the brothel's secrets. Lakan continues to antagonize Jinshi as his connection to Maomao becomes clear.

Episodes.Title: Chance or Something More
Episodes.Description: A discussion with Lihaku about recent events leads Maomao to realize that the mysteries she's helped to solve are connected. As the final piece of the puzzle falls into place, she rushes to stop impending disaster.

Episodes.Title: Thornapple
Episodes.Description: Maomao was able to stop the assassination attempt, but was heavily injured in the process. However, the injuries aren't enough to stop her curiosity, driving her to confront the culprit behind the incident.

Episodes.Title: How to Buy Out a Contract
Episodes.Description: Back to work at the rear palace, Maomao listens to Guen talk about his family's business. Meanwhile, Lihaku hears a rumor that whips him into action.

Episodes.Title: Blue Roses
Episodes.Description: Lakan challenges Jinshi to produce blue roses to present at the upcoming garden party, forcing Jinshi to turn once again to Maomao for her help.

Episodes.Title: Balsam and Woodsorrel
Episodes.Description: No longer willing to keep running away from Lakan, Maomao decides to face off against him. She challenges him on his own turf, in a chess match.

Episodes.Title: Jinshi and Maomao
Episodes.Description: Lakan must now choose a courtesan to buy out. As a high-ranking military official, he can afford to freely choose, even from one of the Three Princesses. Who will he choose? Who does Maomao really want him to choose?

Episodes.Title: Maomao and Maomao
Episodes.Description: The spring garden party concludes without incident. Maomao returns to her regular life as Concubine Gyokuyou’s taster. Meanwhile, novels become popular in the rear palace. Maomao wonders how this came to be, as novels were typically considered low-class. But behind the scenes lies Jinshi and his goals as manager of the rear palace.

Episodes.Title: Caravan
Episodes.Description: The caravan stirs up excitement in the inner palace. The merchants bring all kinds of goods. However, something gives Maomao a bad feeling.

Episodes.Title: Corpse Fungus
Episodes.Description: A concubine passes away, and a woman goes missing. Jinshi sends Maomao to investigate - not these incidents, but mushrooms growing in the rear palace.

Episodes.Title: Mirror
Episodes.Description: The special envoy from a foreign land gifts mirrors - a rarity in this country - to the high concubines. However, they bring mysteries as well.

Episodes.Title: The Moon Fairy
Episodes.Description: In order to realize the seemingly impossible request from the foreign envoy, Maomao speaks to the “Moon Fairy” herself.

Episodes.Title: The Crystal Pavilion, for the Third Time
Episodes.Description: The woman from the clinic finds out that Maomao knows a thing or two about medicine, and asks for her help.

Episodes.Title: The Shrine of Choosing
Episodes.Description: Maomao directs her curiosity towards an old, oddly-shaped building.

Episodes.Title: The Empress Dowager
Episodes.Description: Maomao's reputation for resolving conflicts reaches the empress dowager, who will ask for her help to unravel a mystery that won't leave her mind.

Episodes.Title: The Late Emperor
Episodes.Description: Maomao's investigation of the "curse" reveals more about the late emperor than anticipated.

Episodes.Title: A Ghost Story
Episodes.Description: Maomao joins some women exchanging scary stories on a hot summer night to provide chills.

Episodes.Title: The Hunt
Episodes.Description: Jinshi goes on a hunting trip, and brings Maomao along. He seems ready to share his secret with her.

Episodes.Title: Ka Zuigetsu
Episodes.Description: Maomao discovers Jinshi's secret. She wants nothing to do with whatever the politics behind it is.

Episodes.Title: The Baths
Episodes.Description: Xiaolan's term of service is almost up, so she must find a new job. Maomao and Shisui decide to help.

Episodes.Title: The Dancing Ghost
Episodes.Description: Concubine Lishu reports sightings of a ghost in the baths in her pavilion. Maomao goes to investigate.

Episodes.Title: Ice
Episodes.Description: Xiaolan accidentally ruins an expensive block of ice. Maomao comes up with a delicious backup plan.

Episodes.Title: Festering Resentment
Episodes.Description: Luomen returns to the rear palace. His observations trigger Maomao's curiosity.

Episodes.Title: The Fox Village
Episodes.Description: Suirei smuggles Maomao and Shisui out of the rear palace. Jinshi begins to search for Maomao.

Episodes.Title: Lantern Plant
Episodes.Description: Maomao has been missing for ten days now. Jinshi's investigations lead him to a forgotten graveyard.

Episodes.Title: Festival
Episodes.Description: The village holds a festival. Maomao attends, and Shisui introduces some of the village's history to her.

Episodes.Title: The Stronghold
Episodes.Description: Maomao is taken to a mountain stronghold, where many of the secrets of the Shi clan are revealed to her.

Episodes.Title: Taibon
Episodes.Description: Maomao is accused of attempting to escape, and is tossed into an ancient method of torture and execution.

Episodes.Title: Royal Guard
Episodes.Description: The royal guard, led by Jinshi, arrives, sealing the Shi clan's fate. Maomao wants to save her friend, Shisui.

Episodes.Title: The Shi Clan
Episodes.Description: Jinshi and his forces infiltrate the stronghold, cornering the remaining Shi clan members.

Episodes.Title: The Beginning
Episodes.Description: After the war, Jinshi's work piles up and Maomao returns to the pleasure district.

Entries.Title: Secret Mission - Undercover Agents Never Back Down!
Entries.Description: Narcotics Enforcement Agent Riko Ikazuchi is undercover with her junior colleague Noma in an apartment that serves as the hideout for a criminal organization. Despite Riko and Noma posing as a newlywed couple, the criminals begin to suspect them after not hearing any marital intimacy during the night. To convince them that they are a loving couple, Noma starts touching Riko's body...

Entries.Title: Frieren: Beyond Journey's End
Entries.Description: Decades after her party defeated the Demon King, an old friend's funeral launches the elf wizard Frieren on a journey of self-discovery.

Episodes.Title: The Journey's End
Episodes.Description: The world celebrates the Demon King's defeat at the hands of the Hero and his companions. Now that their great adventure is over, what will Frieren the mage do next?

Episodes.Title: It Didn't Have to Be Magic...
Episodes.Description: Frieren instructs Fern in the use of magic while deciphering a grimoire for Heiter.

Episodes.Title: Killing Magic
Episodes.Description: While retracing the path she took on her adventure with her former traveling companions, Frieren confronts an old enemy.

Episodes.Title: The Land Where Souls Rest
Episodes.Description: Frieren and Fern pay a visit to Eisen, who requests their help in finding the notes of Flamme the Legendary Mage.

Episodes.Title: Phantoms of the Dead
Episodes.Description: Frieren and Fern investigate ghost sightings at a village where people have started going missing.

Episodes.Title: The Hero of the Village
Episodes.Description: Frieren and Fern enlist Stark's help to fight the solar dragon - but is he up to the task?

Episodes.Title: Like a Fairy Tale
Episodes.Description: After reflecting on the transient nature of the past as it exists in people's collective memories, Frieren unexpectedly runs into a sworn enemy.

Episodes.Title: Frieren the Slayer
Episodes.Description: As tensions in Graf Granat's domain reach a breaking point, Fern and Stark find their own resolve - and Frieren resumes an old duty.

Episodes.Title: Aura the Guillotine
Episodes.Description: While Fern and Stark make a temporary retreat with Graf Granat, Frieren's true foe awaits her outside the city.

Episodes.Title: A Powerful Mage
Episodes.Description: Frieren's many years of training under her teacher Flamme are tested in her confrontation with Aura the Guillotine. Will Aura's scales find her wanting?

Episodes.Title: Winter in the Northern Lands
Episodes.Description: Frieren and her companions continue their journey through the northern lands, but obstacles both natural and manmade still stand in their way.

Episodes.Title: A Real Hero
Episodes.Description: Deep in the mountains of the northern lands, Frieren and her party arrive at the Village of the Sword, where they have another job to do.

Episodes.Title: Aversion to One's Own Kind
Episodes.Description: While passing by a village in the woods of the northern lands, Frieren and party meet Sein, a gifted priest who is nonetheless corrupt enough to give even Heiter a run for his money. But what happened in his past?

Episodes.Title: Privilege of the Young
Episodes.Description: The party arrives in a large and lively town with a bustling shopping district that Frieren once visited with Himmel, but something seems to have come up between Fern and Stark.

Episodes.Title: Smells Like Trouble
Episodes.Description: When the party happens upon a town whose inhabitants are all mysteriously asleep, it's time for their newest traveling companion to prove his mettle.

Episodes.Title: Long-Lived Friends
Episodes.Description: Frieren pays a visit to Old Man Voll, a long-lived friend of hers, with traveling companions in tow.

Episodes.Title: Take Care
Episodes.Description: Now that Sein finally has a lead on the whereabouts of his long-lost friend, is it time for him and Frieren's party to part ways?

Episodes.Title: First-Class Mage Exam
Episodes.Description: Frieren and party finally arrive in Äußerst, ready to undergo the first-class mage exam, and meet a number of colorful characters who are there to do the same.

Episodes.Title: Well-Laid Plans
Episodes.Description: Frieren and her new teammates hatch a plan to capture a Stille - but are the other teams just going to stand by and let it happen?

Episodes.Title: Necessary Killing
Episodes.Description: The first-class mage exam intensifies as fighting breaks out between the participants - and what's at stake might even be worth killing for.

Episodes.Title: The World of Magic
Episodes.Description: Frieren, Kanne, and Lawine struggle with the 13th party over possession of the Stille, but there'll be more surprises in store before their battle, and the first test, reach their conclusion.

Episodes.Title: Future Enemies
Episodes.Description: After the conclusion of the first test, the exam participants have some time to kill in town. What do mages get up to on their days off?

Episodes.Title: Conquering the Labyrinth
Episodes.Description: The aspiring first-class mages now face their second test: conquering the Ruins of the King's Tomb. A simple task, or so the proctor claims, but there's a reason this particular dungeon remains unexplored.

Episodes.Title: Perfect Replicas
Episodes.Description: Due to the Spiegel, a legendary monster that can create perfect replicas of others, the test-takers who would conquer the Ruins of the King's Tomb must first face the ultimate enemy: themselves.

Episodes.Title: A Fatal Vulnerability
Episodes.Description: A perfect imitation of Frieren stands between the test-takers and victory, but Fern believes she knows how to win. Is it time for the student to surpass the master?

Episodes.Title: The Height of Magic
Episodes.Description: To defeat Spiegel, Frieren and Fern fight against Frieren's replica, but have a tough time. Meanwhile, Denken, Lavine, and the others fight against the replicas, but the magic of Sense, a first-class mage and the exam's proctor, rages.

Episodes.Title: An Era of Humans
Episodes.Description: With the second test behind them, only one remains - but first, Frieren and Fern need to settle an important matter in town. What awaits them in the third test?

Episodes.Title: It Would Be Embarrassing When We Met Again
Episodes.Description: As the first-class mage exam concludes and the test-takers go their separate ways, farewell leads to departure - but the next stage of Frieren's journey has only just begun.

Entries.Title: Renegade Immortal
Entries.Description: It tells the story of Wang Lin, an ordinary young man in the countryside, who is moved by his heart and cultivates against immortality. His pursuit is not only for longevity, but also for getting rid of the ants behind it. He firmly believed in human beings and entered the path of cultivation with mediocre qualifications. After experiencing ups and downs, with his wise mind, he gradually reached the pinnacle and became famous in the cultivation world with his own strength.

Entries.Title: LEGO Ninjago: Dragons Rising
Entries.Description: After Crystallized, the 16 realms have abruptly fused into a cosmic unstable dystopia. A Spinjitzu Ninja Master trains a new generation of heroes to find Elemental Dragons before the forces of evil exploit that energy to destroy the world.

Episodes.Title: The Merge (1)
Episodes.Description: After a mysterious event known as "The Merge" shuffles the universe, an aspiring Ninja teams with a smart techie to navigate a new and unfamiliar world.

Episodes.Title: The Merge (2)
Episodes.Description: Arin and Sora develop new powers that just might help them confront the dragon hunters. Can the Green Ninja teach them how to harness their abilities?

Episodes.Title: Crossroads Carnival
Episodes.Description: On training day, Arin and Sora sneak out of the monastery to attend the Crossroads Carnival and uncover a villainous plot that tests their skills.

Episodes.Title: Beyond Madness
Episodes.Description: When the Bounty airship returns with no captain, Arin, Sora and Lloyd use clues to figure out what happened to Kai. Is it a trap... or something worse?

Episodes.Title: Writers of Destiny
Episodes.Description: To save Cloud Kingdom, the Ninja must work together to send a terrifying tentacled beast back where it came from and close the Mergequake — and fast!

Episodes.Title: Return to Imperium
Episodes.Description: When the Ninja meet their match in a Photac — an indestructible techno-beast — Sora believes that a mission to Imperium is the only way to destroy it.

Episodes.Title: Mindless Beasts
Episodes.Description: In Imperium, Arin mentors a group of eager young crimefighters. Sora confronts a villain from her past. Lloyd frees an Elemental Master from prison.

Episodes.Title: I Will Be the Danger
Episodes.Description: To bust the imprisoned dragons out of Imperium, the Ninja will need to work hard, think fast and find one big exit! Unless the Photacs get there first.

Episodes.Title: The Calm Inside
Episodes.Description: Sora hacks into the Imperium logs to find Riyu. Nya and Kai explore a mysterious passageway. Lloyd leads an epic battle against an army of Photacs.

Episodes.Title: The Battle of the Second Monastery
Episodes.Description: Ninja never quit! Nya, Kai and Zane give the battle against Imperium new hope while Lloyd uncovers a mystery hidden deep below the city.

Episodes.Title: The Temple of the Dragon Cores
Episodes.Description: To stop the MergeQuakes from getting worse, the Ninja travel to the Temple of the Dragon Cores to learn more about something called "The Coalescence."

Episodes.Title: Gangs of the Sea
Episodes.Description: When the Ninja split up to find the three Dragon Cores, Arin and Lloyd take the airship but soon need help from a village of peaceful algae farmers.

Episodes.Title: Wyldly Inappropriate
Episodes.Description: Mr. Frohicky and Zane head to the Crossroads to locate a Wyconium coil. Elsewhere, Wyldfyre's pranks complicate her and Kai's Dragon Core quest.

Episodes.Title: The Last Djinn
Episodes.Description: Nya's Seeker Stones lead her and Sora to something they weren't searching for. As Zane's Assistant Keeper, Mr. Frohicky can't do anything right.

Episodes.Title: They Call It Doom
Episodes.Description: Sora and Nya search for the Dragon Core with a magical compass. Arin and Lloyd get put to the test in Mother Garden. Wyldfyre and Kai play keep-away.

Episodes.Title: Land of Lost Things
Episodes.Description: In the Land of Lost Things, Nya runs into an old pal while Sora looks for an alternate power source to ward off a junkyard monster called "The Hoarder."

Episodes.Title: The Administration
Episodes.Description: Lloyd and Arin arrive in the Administration, where they learn the Dragon Core will be demolished if they don't act fast — and file the correct paperwork.

Episodes.Title: Absolute Power
Episodes.Description: While the Ninja try to figure out a way to bypass Imperium's energy barrier, Empress Beatrix tests a deadly weapon powered by stolen Dragon Cores.

Episodes.Title: We Are All Dragons
Episodes.Description: To expose Empress Beatrix's mistreatment of dragons to the naïve citizens of Imperium, the Ninja will need help... from a man on the inside.

Episodes.Title: The Power Within
Episodes.Description: Empress Beatrix's rampage pushes the MergeQuakes dangerously close to the tipping point, unless the Ninja can work together — and save the world.

Episodes.Title: The Blood Moon
Episodes.Description: Arin and Sora investigate a mysterious break-in at the junkyard while a sleep-deprived Lloyd suffers from stress dreams about warriors wearing masks.

Episodes.Title: Shattered Dreams
Episodes.Description: The Ninja interrogate a shifty shopkeeper about a stolen mallet. Could the ancient tool be connected to the Cloud Kingdom archives — and Lloyd's visions?

Episodes.Title: Beyond the Phantasm Cave
Episodes.Description: A metal gate. A teacher. And a direction...? Lloyd experiences a vision from the Source Dragons that sends the Ninja on a righteous but unclear quest.

Episodes.Title: Force from the East
Episodes.Description: To meet the legendary teacher from Lloyd's visions, the Ninja must pass a series of tests. But will the ancient master live up to their expectations?

Episodes.Title: The Spell at the Waterfall
Episodes.Description: The Ninja begin their training to defeat the Forbidden Five, but Wyldfyre feels left behind. Bonzle reveals an unexpected connection.

Episodes.Title: To Mysterium
Episodes.Description: Bonzle and her team set out to search for a certain sorceress, but first they'll need a map. Meanwhile, Arin struggles with his Spinjitzu training.

Episodes.Title: Fugitives from Madness
Episodes.Description: With the Blood Moon looming, Bonzle asks her eccentric creator for help while the Ninja have one last chance to master the Rising Dragon technique.

Episodes.Title: Secrets of the Wyldness
Episodes.Description: The Ninja head to the Wyldness, where they must confront Lord Ras — whether they're ready or not. Sorceress reveals her plan for keeping Bonzle safe.

Episodes.Title: The Forest of Spirits
Episodes.Description: Sorceress searches the storehouse for a spell to rescue Bonzle while Arin intercepts a special package. Then, the remaining Ninja infiltrate the ritual.

Episodes.Title: Rising Ninja
Episodes.Description: With the sacrifices, spell and Blood Moon in his control, Lord Ras has everything he needs to unleash the Forbidden Five — unless the Ninja can act fast!

Episodes.Title: The Shape of Motion
Episodes.Description: Lloyd attempts to decipher his visions, while Arin uncovers a mysterious theft that threatens the Sixteen Realms while searching for his parents.

Episodes.Title: Enter the City of Temples
Episodes.Description: The Ninja get a big surprise when they arrive at the Tournament of the Sources, while Kai and Bonzle contend with the Forbidden Five in the Nether-Space.

Episodes.Title: They Gather for the Feast
Episodes.Description: Arin runs into an old friend at the Tournament of the Sources, the Ninja explore the City of Temples, and Lloyd sees a strangely familiar face.

Episodes.Title: Inside the Maze
Episodes.Description: Master Wu sets out to discipline the Ninja — through dance! Arin reunites with Frak, who Sora doesn’t trust, and the fighting gets underway.

Episodes.Title: United We Fall
Episodes.Description: Nerves fray and tempers flare as the Ninja prepare to compete. Wyldfyre squares off against Cinder, leading to a serious setback for the gang.

Episodes.Title: Truth and Lies
Episodes.Description: As the Ninja fight to win the Temple Race, Ras makes a shocking claim to Arin — putting him at odds with his friends — just as the tournament heats up.

Episodes.Title: The Sword Shatters
Episodes.Description: Kai makes a discovery that allows him to speak with his sister. Arin visits the Temple City museum where he has a breakthrough about the missing horns.

Episodes.Title: Clues and Suspects
Episodes.Description: Wyldfyre teams up with Arin to find out if Roby is behind the stolen horns. Later, at Bleckt’s office, they make a startling discovery.

Episodes.Title: The Final Game
Episodes.Description: Master Wu confirms Arin’s worst fears, and the location of the horns comes to light. Later, Wyldfyre drops a truth bomb at the tournament.

Episodes.Title: Elements of Betrayal
Episodes.Description: The Wolf Mask army battles the Elemental Masters as the Ninja converge on the Monastery of Gates to stop Nokt from freeing the Forbidden Five.

Episodes.Title: The Missing
Episodes.Description: Sora's pie-baking failure gives Zane an idea for how to find Arin, and the crew frees a village from a giant puppet's reign of terror on the way.

Episodes.Title: The Ultimate Object of Admiration
Episodes.Description: The search for Arin — who continues his training with Ras — leads the Ninja into a dangerous confrontation with a ferocious cyclops.

Episodes.Title: The Spectral Lands
Episodes.Description: In the Spectral Lands, Ras sends Arin to retrieve a healing elixir from the Well of the Lost. Kai hatches an ingenious plan to find Jay.

Episodes.Title: The Great Zane Robbery
Episodes.Description: Zane's run-in with looters at a strange monastery leads to a reunion with an old friend, but he also crosses paths with one of the Forbidden Five.

Episodes.Title: I Alone Can Save Them
Episodes.Description: The reunited Ninja learn of the Forbidden Five's dangerous quest to find the Prismatic Blades. Meanwhile, Ras leads Arin across a desert.

Episodes.Title: Fallen Wishes
Episodes.Description: Arrakore the djinn transports Sora, Nya and Riyu to New Djinjago. Ras enlists Arin in his plan to reverse the Merge.

Episodes.Title: Their Draconic Majesty's Request
Episodes.Description: A mysterious mercenary attacks Ras and Arin in the World Forest. Zane and P.I.X.A.L. try a new approach in their search for the Prismatic Blades.

Episodes.Title: Crashing Together
Episodes.Description: The Ninja catch up with Arin in the World Forest and try to convince him to leave Ras, and the reason for Arin and Sora's deep bond is revealed.

Episodes.Title: Chaos Unchained
Episodes.Description: Heavily outnumbered, the Ninja race to stop the Forbidden Five from freeing Thunderfang. Wyldfyre desperately tries to cure one of the crew.

Episodes.Title: The Shatter Dragon
Episodes.Description: Lloyd attracts the attention of a powerful adversary. The intervention of the mysterious mercenary tips the balance in an epic battle.

Episodes.Title: The Hollow Ones
Episodes.Description: Ras leads Arin and Sora into unexpected chaos in Mysterium while the Ninja recruit Jay for a special mission.

Episodes.Title: Human Resources
Episodes.Description: With Mysterium under attack, Ras, Arin and Sora rely on the Sorceress for help, while Jay leads the Ninja to the Administration on their way to Lee.

Episodes.Title: Between You and Lee
Episodes.Description: Lloyd, Jay, Nya and Wyldfyre go undercover in the strange Land of Lee, while Riyu's training under Rontu is off to a bumpy start.

Episodes.Title: Casket of Bones
Episodes.Description: The Underworld tests Arin and Sora's commitment to Ras, while Nya and Jay work together to expose Lee's secret.

Episodes.Title: The Screaming Earth
Episodes.Description: Cole, Frak and Kai unearth a shocking discovery outside the Land of Lost Things, while the Ninja reunite to liberate Lee.

Episodes.Title: Under the Light of a Mechanical Moon
Episodes.Description: The Ninja escape Lee and head for the source of the threat, while Ras plans his next move.

Episodes.Title: The Vault of Focus
Episodes.Description: In the City of Temples, the Ninja find guidance from an unlikely source, while Cole, Kai and Frak battle the Hollow Ones in Imperium.

Episodes.Title: For Whom the Bell Tolls
Episodes.Description: The Ninja embark on their separate journeys to awaken the Arc Dragon of Focus but deal with unexpected - and annoying - interruptions.

Episodes.Title: When Doves Cry
Episodes.Description: The Ninja reach the Caves of Bells while Lloyd and Arin fight their way through the Spectral Lands to summon the Arc Dragon.

Episodes.Title: Chaos Reigns
Episodes.Description: ThunderFang gathers the last of his power in the Spectral Lands and only the Ninja can stop him - but at what cost?

Entries.Title: Fufu Kokan: Modorenai Yoru
Entries.Description: Reiji and his wife joined their friends on a getaway to a traditional Japanese inn, hoping to conceive a child. However, their plans took an unexpected turn when Reiji was seduced by his friend's wife, while his own wife engaged in a passionate affair with their mutual friend.  Amidst forbidden desires and the thrill of pushing boundaries, the four of them delved deeper into temptation.  As they surrendered to their carnal passions, could they ever reclaim the innocence of their marriages?

Episodes.Title: The Wonders of the World!
Episodes.Description: At the Crystal Pool, Rystal recalls when she, Lucius and Gibeon reached Laqua.

Episodes.Title: Wynaut? Wy-Yes!
Episodes.Description: The Rising Volt Tacklers meet up with a former member who might know Entei's whereabouts.

Episodes.Title: Ludlow's Homecoming!
Episodes.Description: A trip to Olivine City gives Ludlow a chance to reminisce about his home town.

Episodes.Title: Entei's Fierce Battle Cry!
Episodes.Description: The Rising Volt Tacklers work together to battle Entei after finally tracking it down.

Episodes.Title: Over the Top
Episodes.Description: Chairwoman Geeta challenges Liko, Roy and Dot to a battle to test their strength.

Episodes.Title: Tota-lie Awesome Pokémon in Area Zero?!
Episodes.Description: A descent into the Great Crater of Paldea reveals wonders and Pokémon beyond imagination.

Episodes.Title: The Pillar of Fire
Episodes.Description: The Rising Volt Tacklers locate Entei of the Six Heroes, but something seems off.

Episodes.Title: Beyond the Shining Rainbow
Episodes.Description: The Rising Volt Tacklers finally get a rematch with the Black Rayquaza!

Episodes.Title: The Truth Revealed!
Episodes.Description: Amethio searches for answers about his grandfather's history and goals.

Episodes.Title: Where the Land Meets the Sky
Episodes.Description: The Rising Volt Tacklers visit a mountain town on the way to Laqua.

Episodes.Title: The Pokémon Paradise of Laqua
Episodes.Description: Following a long journey, the Rising Volt Tacklers finally reach Laqua!

Episodes.Title: The Rising Volt Tacklers v the Explorers!
Episodes.Description: The Rising Volt Tacklers and the Explorers battle over the fate of Laqua.

Episodes.Title: Guided by the Black Rayquaza!
Episodes.Description: After 100 years, the secrets of Laqua finally come to light.

Episodes.Title: The Earthshaking White Zygarde
Episodes.Description: Liko and friends show their strength in a battle against Gibeon and the White Zygarde.

Episodes.Title: Where the Adventure Leads
Episodes.Description: Terapagos uses its power to purify Laqua, but a new threat waits in the shadows.

Episodes.Title: Towards the Sky Again (1)
Episodes.Description: It has been one year since the decisive battle in Rakua. One day Roy, who has continued adventuring with Captain Pikachu, learns about a Pokémon that's acting abnormally, and decides to investigate. A young boy named Uruto then appears, accompanied by a Yamirami... In the forest, Roy and Uruto spot a Kekking on a Rakulium-induced rampage?! How can this be, when the Rakulium was supposedly completely destroyed? Liko, on the other hand, is attending Sekiei Academy, when she suddenly...

Episodes.Title: Towards the Sky Again (2)
Episodes.Description: No description available

Episodes.Title: Follow the Laqurium Signs
Episodes.Description: Liko and Roy once again set out on a journey, this time in order to restore the truth about the Rising Volt Tacklers. Using information they receive from Dot, they chase down a Pokémon affected by Rakulium. This leads them to a place with countless holes in the ground, as well as traces of Rakulium...! Suddenly, a savage Haganeil shows up! How will Liko and Roy take on this Pokémon that boasts an impregnable defense?!

Episodes.Title: Super-Stans?! A Gurumin Fan Battle!!
Episodes.Description: Gurumin receives an eyewitness report regarding the Black Rayquaza! Liko and Roy go to the town where the eyewitness lives, where they find the passionate Gurumin fan "Nyabby Girl". However, Nyabby Girl's attitude changes completely when she learns Liko and the others are members of the Rising Volt Tacklers! A battle starts, and Nyabby Girl sends out a Gaogaen, which Masquernya is at a type disadvantage against... What will Liko do?!

Episodes.Title: The Pokémon Center Lady
Episodes.Description: When Liko and the others learn that more and more Pokémon in a forest are getting sick, they begin to investigate whether or not this is because the Pokémon are affected by Rakulium. In the process, they run into Molly, who's treating poisoned wild Pokémon! Molly is currently working at a Pokémon Center... but the happy reunion gets interrupted by cries from scared Pokémon coming from the depths of the forest....! As they continue further in, they find a berserk Ruffresia scattering poison in all directions...?!

Episodes.Title: Strong Sphere
Episodes.Description: Liko and Roy make their way into an Exceed Testing Center where a demonstration battle showcasing the "Strong Sphere", a new product that makes Pokémon stronger, is taking place. However, just then Uruto arrives at the Testing Center as well...

Episodes.Title: Clash! The Dragon Speed Gang
Episodes.Description: Liko and the others learn of an eyewitness account of the Black Rayquaza near Fusube City, the home of a clan of Dragon Pokémon Trainers, but when they head there to investigate, a trio of masked Mototokage riders show up.

Episodes.Title: The Mischievous Maggyo's Great Smile?
Episodes.Description: Nanjyamo asks Dot to come visit her in Hakko City, where a high number of pranks have apparently been played on Pokémon lately to scare them. When Dot checks the footage of these pranks, it turns out they're actually being played by a Maggyo?! It's quite fast too... could this be due to it being affected by Rakulium? Dot heads downtown to investigate, where she encounters...?!

Episodes.Title: Reunion in Cercle Town!
Episodes.Description: Liko and the others reunite with Murdock in Cercle Town. Murdock gets really worried when he learns that they have reformed the Rising Volt Tacklers and are investigating Rakulium.

Episodes.Title: With a Flightless Orio
Episodes.Description: Liko and the others go to Karna's factory in the Galar region to meet with Orio, but when they ask her to build them an airship, she refuses, telling them to ask someone else. Liko and the others find themselves at their wits' end... but then Cap suddenly senses something and runs towards the forest. And believe it or not, there they find... the Brave Asagi, which they had been told had been dismantled!!

Episodes.Title: We Are the Rising Volteccers!
Episodes.Description: Liko, Roy, Dot and Uruto end up battling the Explorers at Karna's factory, where they have quite a difficult time against the Paldea Kentauros that have been strengthened by Strong Spheres. They observe the Kentauros' behavior and try to find a hint towards how to overcome them, however...?! And what does Orio feel when she sees Liko and the others' refusal to give up?

Episodes.Title: Fight! Terastal VS Mega Evolution!!
Episodes.Description: Liko and the others go to Orange Academy to meet with Omodaka and Principal Clavel in order to tell them the truth about the Strong Spheres. They also go to talk with Zinnia to find out what the actual connection between Rakulium and Pokémon is. Roy then meets Nemo again, and the two have their first battle in quite a while. It's time for a fierce fight between two Fighting types to begin: Lucario VS Parmot!

Episodes.Title: The Knight Encountered in the Ruins
Episodes.Description: Liko and the others travel to the ruins in the Paldea region, where they split up and start investigating the Rakulium Signs... however, Roy, Uruto and Dot fall under a Collecurei's control and become obsessed with searching for coins instead! Meanwhile, Liko runs into Karato, a student from Orange Academy searching for his partner Scovillain. In addition, Pagogo reunites with a certain Pokémon in the ruins...!!

Episodes.Title: Burn, Gurumin Love!
Episodes.Description: Nanjamo and Gurumin are going to do a collab event, which Gurumin fan Liko is overjoyed about. Zir from the Explorers had been planning to attend as well, but ended up accidentally losing his entry ticket.

Episodes.Title: Carbou's Wish
Episodes.Description: After deciding to search for Amethio alongside Zir and Conia, Liko visits his house. There, she discovers a photo of Amethio as a child, taken on the only family vacation he ever went on... Placing their trust in this faint clue, the trio heads to the island the photo was taken on! Will they be able to find Amethio...?!

Episodes.Title: Surfing Surfugo After the Storm
Episodes.Description: As Amethio is flying through the storm on his Armorga, he's about to fall into the sea when he gets rescued by... none other than Mighty G?! The two decide to rest in a nearby cave until the storm subsides, and for some reason they end up making curry rice...?! And then, after the storm, Liko and the others visit a beach where Surfugo tend to appear...

Episodes.Title: Mega Awesome!? The Unopenable Dark Ball
Episodes.Description: After a fight with Roy, Uruto runs away from the group, after which he encounters and befriends a boy named Rayu accompanied by a Taggingru. Uruto shows Rayu his cherished Dark Ball, but when he wakes up the next morning, he finds that the Dark Ball is gone.

Episodes.Title: Two People, As Friends
Episodes.Description: Uruto infiltrates the Explorers' hideout, but ends up getting discovered and captured! His rescue comes in the form of... Roy! The two of them attempt to escape, but Rubella and Indi block their way... and the duo struggles greatly against their Strong Sphere-strengthened Pokémon. Just then, Uruto's Kairyu starts to...?!

Episodes.Title: Diana Comes Back!!!!
Episodes.Description: Liko's grandmother Diana returns to the ship for the first time in quite a while. The new information she's obtained concerns a way to completely eradicate the Rakulium......? Liko and Diana also end up having a battle in order to train Liko's Carbou. How will Carbou take on Windie, who's likewise a Fire type?

Episodes.Title: How Nakanuchan Makes the Ultimate Hammer
Episodes.Description: Nakanuchan is once again cheerfully searching for iron to create the ultimate hammer! However, just when it finds some iron it really likes, the iron gets collected by a truck... Even after returning to the airship, Nakanuchan is unable to forget about this iron, so it dives off the ship just as it's about to take off...?! At the same time, Sango and Onyx are on the move, riding in an Armorga Taxi...

Episodes.Description: No description available

Episodes.Description: No description available

Episodes.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: The Seven Deadly Sins: Four Knights of the Apocalypse
Entries.Description: As a prophecy of doom unfolds on the peaceful land of Britannia, a purehearted boy sets out on a journey of discovery — and revenge.

Episodes.Title: THE BOY'S DEPARTURE
Episodes.Description: As Percival turns sixteen, his grandfather tells him about the big world beyond their far-flung home — but the young man seems more interested in dinner.

Episodes.Title: THE UNKNOWN FORCE
Episodes.Description: On a journey to find his estranged father, Percival comes across a group of traveling performers who give him a lift to the nearest village.

Episodes.Title: THE FOUR KNIGHTS OF THE APOCALYPSE
Episodes.Description: Although Percival puts up a good fight, the black knight hasn't unleashed his full powers yet. Suddenly, a mysterious red fox appears.

Episodes.Title: THE DEMON OF ECHO GORGE
Episodes.Description: Percival wakes up to find himself tied up and experimented on. His captor tells him that he's almost perfected the medicine he's been developing.

Episodes.Title: A RESOLVE FURTHER HONED
Episodes.Description: To return his grandfather to his original form, Nasiens will have to defeat another Holy Knight, and Percival is determined to help.

Episodes.Title: SISTANA SHAKEN
Episodes.Description: Percival and his friends come across a fierce young woman named Anne who, against her father's will, dreams of becoming a Holy Knight.

Episodes.Title: THE NAME OF THE MAGIC
Episodes.Description: Although Ironside completely overpowers them, Percival, Anne and Nasiens put up a brave fight. But Donny is nowhere to be seen.

Episodes.Title: YOUNG HEROES
Episodes.Description: While Percival and crew struggle to destroy the Coffin of Eternal Darkness, a powerful mysterious ally faces the monsters raiding the town.

Episodes.Title: MASTER AND PUPIL
Episodes.Description: The group — now joined by an exuberant Anne — make a stop in the rough town of Cant, where Donny has an awkward family reunion.

Episodes.Title: ROAR OF DESTRUCTION
Episodes.Description: While held captive, Howzer, Nasiens and the others find out that Edlin has stolen a dragon's egg, putting the whole town in danger.

Episodes.Title: A REAL HOLY KNIGHT
Episodes.Description: As Percival, Donny and Anne have their hands full trying to stop the rampaging dragon, the still drunk Howzer asks Nasiens to sober him up.

Episodes.Title: A SINISTER ENDEAVOR
Episodes.Description: On the way to Liones Kingdom, Sin experiences a peculiar dream. The next morning, despite a passerby's warning, the crew stumbles upon a strange village.

Episodes.Title: THE CORNERED
Episodes.Description: Percival faces off against Kellie, a powerful and merciless mythical beast. The crew chases Ardbeg into a mysterious cave, only to find out it's a trap.

Episodes.Title: THE GOAT SIN
Episodes.Description: Ardbeg's magic transforms Percival and his crew into helpless babies. The elder of the demon clan village comes to their rescue, presenting an ultimatum.

Episodes.Title: THE DARK TALISMANS
Episodes.Description: Arthur's men, hiding in the distance, ambush Gowther and Ardbeg. Restored to their original forms, Percival and his crew continue their perilous journey.

Episodes.Title: DEPARTING FROM SIN
Episodes.Description: Percival and his crew go head-to-head with the Dark Talismans. However, Fiddick devises a plan to defeat the young crew's source of strength.

Episodes.Title: THE KING OF LIONES
Episodes.Description: Arriving at Liones Kingdom, Percival and his crew head to the castle to meet the king. But they find him absent, and soon Percival strays into trouble.

Episodes.Title: KIGHTS OF PROPHECY MEET
Episodes.Description: The former king has an ominous dream about the Four Knights. Percival and his crew are introduced to Tristan and set off in search of the fourth knight.

Episodes.Title: LIONES IN FLAMES
Episodes.Description: A mysterious girl appears before Lancelot, delivering a prophecy. Meanwhile, a hostile drunkard provokes a fight with a Ruby Holy Knight.

Episodes.Title: TAMING A WILD HORSE
Episodes.Description: The Four Knights of Apocalypse finally gather together in one place. However, they can't agree on how to handle Pellegarde — until Percival steps in.

Episodes.Title: THE FOUR KNIGHTS VS THE SERVANTS OF CHAOS
Episodes.Description: Under Arthur's orders, powerful members of the demon clan wreak havoc in the kingdom. Meliodas seeks to uncover the truth behind King Arthur's motives.

Episodes.Title: FREEZING, BURNING HEARTS
Episodes.Description: The Four Knights collaborate to combat the servants of Chaos. Meanwhile, sensing imminent danger, Lancelot makes his way to the castle.

Episodes.Title: ROYAL HOLY KNIGHTS VS MELA-GALLAND
Episodes.Description: With Lancelot missing, Galland and Melascula resurrect by fusing together. Outmatched, Percival, Tristan and Gawain need all the help they can get.

Episodes.Title: ADVENT
Episodes.Description: Drawing strength from the people's hope, Percival faces Mela-Galland, who proves to be too powerful. Tristan takes a dangerous risk to counterattack.

Episodes.Title: THE POWER OF THE KING
Episodes.Description: King Arthur of Camelot makes a grand entrance and offers an enticing promise to the people of Liones. Later, Arthur and Meliodas cross swords.

Episodes.Title: PREPARED TO PART WAYS
Episodes.Description: After a restless night, Percival and his companions receive Meliodas's summons to the audience chamber. He asks if they are ready to part ways.

Episodes.Title: GUINEVERE
Episodes.Description: While the other Knights prepare for their imminent departure, Lancelot has a fateful meeting with Guinevere, who has a unique ability.

Episodes.Title: CONFRONTATION
Episodes.Description: Guinevere arrives in Camelot just as she's predicted and meets King Arthur. Meanwhile, the Four Knights arrive at their first stop: Wolnack.

Episodes.Title: CITY OF BATTLE
Episodes.Description: As Percival and the rest enjoy the festivities, Tristan is led away by his new roommate. The group splits up to find him, unaware of the looming danger.

Episodes.Title: FLAMES OF REMINISCENCES
Episodes.Description: Percival's group might have captured their enemy, but they can't agree on the next step. Elsewhere, Isolde, Anne and Jade face a deadly surprise attack.

Episodes.Title: THE CRAZED KING
Episodes.Description: While grieving their tragic loss, the Four Knights try to enter Camelot with Teaninich's help but soon discover they must find another way forward.

Episodes.Title: THE SAVIOR
Episodes.Description: The Four Knights and their companions arrive in the demon realm, where they learn more about Percival's mysterious past, and a touching reunion awaits.

Episodes.Title: BEHEMOTH OF CALAMITY
Episodes.Description: While Gawain battles Mortlach's group, the other Knights learn about the perilous path ahead: the door to Camelot is on the back of a monstrous beast.

Episodes.Title: WAVERING HEARTS
Episodes.Description: In preparation for their upcoming quest, Lancelot puts Percival through harsh swordsmanship training. Meanwhile, Schwarz challenges Tristan to a showdown.

Episodes.Title: THE BOY OF DESTINY
Episodes.Description: After unleashing a new form of his power, Percival continues training with Lancelot. Later, hitchhikers threaten the Knights' quest to find the Behemoth.

Episodes.Title: BANQUET FOR BRAVES
Episodes.Description: While in a trance, Percival learns the shocking truth behind his existence. Later, the two factions face off in an intense showdown.

Entries.Title: MASHLE: MAGIC AND MUSCLES
Entries.Description: With no magic but plenty of physical might, Mash makes it his goal to outdo his magic-wielding classmates to attain the title of Divine Visionary.

Episodes.Title: Mash Burnedead and the Body of the Gods
Episodes.Description: This is the Magic Realm. Naturally, all who reside in this world can use magic. Magic is a normal part of everyday life. But deep within a certain forest lives a boy named Mash and his father-figure, Regro. Mash was frequently told to avoid going into town. The reason being, the mark that is ever present on everyone’s face does not exist on Mash — for he cannot use magic. One day, while Regro is away, Mash ventures into town to buy his favorite cream puffs....

Episodes.Title: Mash Burnedead and the Mysterious Maze
Episodes.Description: For the sake of living peacefully with Regro, Mash decided to take the admission exam for the prestigious Easton Magic Academy in order to be selected as the most excellent and valued student — the Divine Visionary. Only those with exceptional magic power can pass the admission exam, so he smashes through various exams with power. In the maze exam, Mash is approached by a female student name Lemon, and together they aim to reach the goal.

Episodes.Title: Mash Burnedead and the Baleful Bully
Episodes.Description: Mash continues life at the magic academy with the help of Finn, with whom he shares the same dorm room. One day, Mash is called out by Lloyd, a continuing student similar to Finn, and is unwittingly made into an errand boy under the impression it will help him become the Divine Visionary. As the situation gradually escalates, he coincidentally discovers Finn lying in front of Lloyd, bleeding...!

Episodes.Title: Mash Burnedead and the Challenging Magic User
Episodes.Description: It is decided that Mash will participate in "Duelo," a popular sport in the Magic Realm that uses brooms, to represent Adler Dorm. During the match, a player of the opposing team from Lang Dorm begins to widen the gap between the scores with cowardly acts such as striking last year's MVP, Tom. As Adler Dorm finds themselves in a clutch, will Mash be able to use his muscles to lead them to victory...?! Later, Mash is suddenly approached by the top exam student with two marks, the handsome Lance...!

Episodes.Title: Mash Burnedead and the Unpopular Classmate
Episodes.Description: It is a match against Lance with their silver coins on the line. Victorious, Mash manages to rescue Finn, Lemon, and Tom from the bottle. While smoothly moving through classes and assignments, a joint extracurricular activity is held for the Adler and Lang Dorms. Their task is to dispatch the forest scorpions to earn coins. After entering the forest and ending up lost and alone, Mash winds up working with a first-year student from his dorm named Dot...?!

Episodes.Title: Mash Burnedead and the Magic of Iron
Episodes.Description: Mash and Dot are spotted by Silva, a Lang dorm student known for his bad behavior. Silva offers a bet on whether the boys can endure five hits each of his magic. Silva says he'll give up a silver coin if he can endure, and Dot says he'll take hits for Mash, too. Dot withstands ten hits, but Silva reveals the brutal reality. Looking on, Mash takes decisive action.

Episodes.Title: Mash Burnedead and the Puppet Master
Episodes.Description: Mash beats Silva, defeats the giant forest scorpion, and successfully completes the joint extracurricular activity. The five silver coins collected become one gold coin, and Mash learns about the existence of Lang Dorm’s core students who hunt coins — the seven students of the Magia Lupus. But later, Mash, searching for his next classroom, wanders into the Magia Lupus stronghold. Although he makes it out alive, a black shadow approaches Mash and his friends while cleaning out the owl huts….

Episodes.Title: Mash Burnedead and the Wolves of Magic
Episodes.Description: After Mash and Lance defeat Olore and Anser of the Magia Lupus, Abyss appears before them to collect his comrades, leaving behind a disturbing atmosphere. Mash discusses the future with Lance while baking cream puffs when Lemon rushes in. It seems that Tom has temporarily lost his ability to use magic. That night, while Mash and his friends explore the school to unravel the mystery, they discover a strange-looking Lemon....

Episodes.Title: Mash Burnedead and the Accelerated Battle
Episodes.Description: After chasing Lemon and discovering a door to the basement, Mash and the others are confronted by the Magia Lupus at the bottom of their way down. It's Lance vs. the Third Fang Wirth and Mash vs. the Second Fang Abyss. The decisive battle begins!!

Episodes.Title: Mash Burnedead and the Divine Visionary
Episodes.Description: While Mash and Lance beat their respective opponents and proceed to help Lemon, Dot and Finn battle the Fifth Fang Love and the Forth Fang Milo. Dot fiercely struggles against Love's strength, but due to something unexpected, his magical power suddenly increases, and he undergoes a transformation. The secret is...?

Episodes.Title: Mash Burnedead and the Survival of the Fittest
Episodes.Description: Even with a win over Love, Dot is battered and bruised. Milo gives up on using petrification magic on Mash and launches an attack on Dot. Suddenly, the Divine Visionary Rayne appears, and Milo collapses in an instant. Rayne was informed by Wahlberg that Innocent Zero's agents were coming to school, and he showed up to respond. Meanwhile, Mash has made his way to the First Fang Abel. Mash reveals his quiet rage. What will be the course of this decisive battle?!

Episodes.Title: Mash Burnedead and the Magic Mirror
Episodes.Description: Mash overcomes Abel. Other than Lemon, Mash and the others are overjoyed after the other students are released from being transformed into puppets. Meanwhile, Rayne confronts a member of Innocent Zero who disguised himself as Lance. But he is left behind, and the Innocent Zero agent escapes to go after Abel, who is no longer of use. A new threat creeps up upon Mash and his friends...!

Episodes.Title: Mash Burnedead and the Divine Visionaries
Episodes.Description: After Cell War from Innocent Zero leaves, a rumor that Mash can't use magic begins to spread around the school. On the other hand, Mash and his friends win the battle against Magia Lupus and take Lang Dorm's coins for the Alder Dorm, thus bringing them a step closer to becoming Divine Visionaries. After school, they celebrate their victory with a party with Abel and Abyss joining them, when an owl suddenly appears and drops off a letter...

Episodes.Title: Mash Burnedead and the Home Visit
Episodes.Description: The Bureau of Magic calls upon an emergency inquiry regarding the concealment of Mash's lack of magic, and the Divine Visionaries gather one by one before Mash. The Divine Visionaries seek punishment for Mash on this, but Rayne and Wahlberg bow their heads down in a plea. Thus, the Divine Visionaries offer to defer the punishment on the condition that Mash becomes a Divine Visionary Candidate. Dot and the rest learn of this, and then everyone goes off to have some fun...?

Episodes.Title: Rayne Ames and God's Gift
Episodes.Description: Right before the selection exam, Mash goes home with Finn and the rest of the gang, where Regro is waiting for him. For a brief moment, Mash and his friends can enjoy a calming break, but the prefect from Orca Dorm, Margarette Macaron, draws in closer to the group. Divine Visionary Rayne, however, stands in the way of Macaron. As Mash and his friends enjoy board games, a high-caliber fight between Macaron and Rayne unfolds in the background!

Episodes.Title: Mash Burnedead and the Brawny Balloon
Episodes.Description: The Divine Visionary Selection Exam finally begins. Traditionally, only those who have collected five or more coins were allowed to take the selection exam, but with Innocent Zero's interfering and the exam being accelerated this year, anybody with three or more coins is qualified to take the exam. Mash, Finn, Lance, and Dot, now qualified to take the exam, challenge themselves to a dead-or-alive qualifying round, also known as "Deadervant's Haunt."

Episodes.Title: Finn Ames and the Friend
Episodes.Description: Mash and his friends safely passed the first round of the selection exam and were formed into a team of three out of the nine people who passed. Their next challenge is “The Life Crystal,” a competition where teams must simply break the other teams’ crystals. However, two of the three people on Mash's team (consisting of him, Dot, and Finn) break the crystals given to them before the challenge even starts. With only one crystal left for their team, the three members start the game in different locations. Finn then encounters Carpaccio Luo-yang from the Orca Dorm…

Episodes.Title: Mash Burnedead and You Look, You Lose Your Life
Episodes.Description: Finn refuses to abandon his friends and faces off against Carpaccio while Mash rushes to save Finn. There are 13 ancient wands said to exist in the Magic World, known as the “Master Canes.” Carpaccio was chosen by one of them and was considered invincible as he was able to void any wounds. Mash completely defeats him. Margarette defeats Carpaccio’s two other team members elsewhere, ending the challenge. And just before the last exam, somebody comes to meet Mash and his friends in the waiting room…

Episodes.Title: Mash Burnedead and the Magical Maestro
Episodes.Description: The last test of the Divine Visionary Candidate Exam is a one-on-one battle. The first match pits Mash against Margarette. Mash faces off against Macaron, a magic user said to have great magic power and is treated on the same level as a Divine Visionary. How and where will this tough fight end?

Episodes.Title: Mash Burnedead and the Tall Tower
Episodes.Description: Mash wins against Macaron, but Innocent Zero unexpectedly appears from the sky and freezes time in the exam venue. Wahlberg confronts Innocent Zero. Kaldo and other Divine Visionaries along with prefect Margarette, now unfrozen, face off against monsters to protect the students. At the same time, a battle between Mash and Cell War unfolds!

Episodes.Title: Wahlberg Baigan and the Magic of Darkness
Episodes.Description: Sitter Baby, one of Innocent Zero’s army of death row inmates, the Criminal Canes, turns Lance and Dot into babies. But Lance manages to defeat Sitter Baby with his overwhelming strength. Midair in the distant sky, Innocent Zero uses a forbidden spell to resurrect Adam Jobs, whom Wahlberg faces off with. Adam was considered a top legendary magic user in the Magic Realm and Wahlberg and Innocent Zero’s master at the same time…

Episodes.Title: Wahlberg Baigan and the Greatest Danger
Episodes.Description: Although Cell used the true, summoned power of his wand, Mash decidedly defeated him. At the same time, Wahlberg shows his ever-powerful abilities to face off with Criminal Cane’s Necromance and Adam’s dark magic, both of which Innocent Zero controls. And finally, the peak showdown between Wahlberg and Innocent Zero begins!

Episodes.Title: Mash Burnedead and the Origin of the Greatest Magic User
Episodes.Description: In exchange for his life, Wahlberg attempts to whittle down Innocent Zero by manifesting Thirds, which opens the true power of his wand. Innocent Zero manages to escape the spell using his superior magic. Fallen into a desperate situation with no escape, Wahlberg is saved by…none other than Mash Burnedead himself!

Episodes.Title: Mash Burnedead and His Good Friends
Episodes.Description: Innocent Zero leaves a fusion of dead monster bodies that form a giant in his wake. Seeing Mash fight against this monster in a trapped, hopeless situation where all magic has become ineffective, the students from the school start to cheer him on.

Entries.Title: The Dangers in My Heart
Entries.Description: Kyotaro Ichikawa, a boy barely clinging to the bottom rung of his school's social ladder, secretly believes he’s the tortured lead in some psychological thriller. He spends his days dreaming up ways to disrupt his classmates' peaceful lives and pining after Anna Yamada, the class idol. But Kyotaro's not nearly the troubled teen he pretends to be…and it turns out Anna's a bit odd herself!

Episodes.Title: I Was Stolen Away
Episodes.Description: At first glance, he’s just the disturbed boy, and she’s just the popular girl. But people are more than the sum of their parts, as both Kyotaro and Anna are about to discover.

Episodes.Title: I Died
Episodes.Description: Despite his misgivings, Kyotaro keeps helping Anna the more they interact. He may be a better person than he believes.

Episodes.Title: I Want to Hug You
Episodes.Description: Anna and her friends keep their guard up around the boys; it’s obvious what they want. But Kyotaro’s different. Each brief interaction brings him and Anna closer together.

Episodes.Title: I Have a Problem
Episodes.Description: Like many people his own age, Kyotaro has a tendency to overthink everything. Anna, however? She has her own way of approaching life.

Episodes.Title: We Got Split Up
Episodes.Description: It’s not like Kyotaro wants to join Anna’s group or anything. But when a certain other classmate tries to join the group, Kyotaro just gets swept up in events. That’s all!

Episodes.Title: I Melted It
Episodes.Description: As Kyotaro wrestles with his feelings, he notices Anna’s been acting differently. Could it be that she—? No, he shouldn’t read too much into it. She’s just being nice. Right?

Episodes.Title: We Swapped Places
Episodes.Description: Kyotaro can no longer deny he likes Anna. He tells himself it’s not like he wants to be her boyfriend, but there’s a detail he hasn’t considered: maybe Anna wants him to be.

Episodes.Title: I Had a Dream
Episodes.Description: Parent-teacher day mortifies Kyotaro. Not only is his mother at school, but she’s bonding with Anna! Things couldn’t get any worse.

Episodes.Title: I Hate Yamada
Episodes.Description: Despite all the hints Anna throws at him, and others beginning to notice, Kyotaro refuses to believe that she could actually like him. He is his own worst enemy.

Episodes.Title: We Walked Slowly
Episodes.Description: It’s Japan’s most romantic time of the year, and Kyotaro and Anna are not-on-a-date. Kyotaro is keeping a running tally of all his screw-ups, but Anna is enjoying herself.

Episodes.Title: We’re a Bit Alike
Episodes.Description: Distance separates Kyotaro and Anna, but their thoughts are of each other. However, their budding relationship faces a threat: Haruya still has his eyes set on Anna.

Episodes.Title: I Wanted to Be Seen
Episodes.Description: Kyotaro didn’t think his cunning plan for New Year’s all the way through. Anna showed up early, and now his sister is trying to be his wingwoman.

Episodes.Title: We're Searching
Episodes.Description: Anna wants to help Kyotaro since he has a broken arm, but she's unaware of the secret he's keeping from her.

Episodes.Title: I'm Growing Up
Episodes.Description: It's the first time Kyotaro has ever been in Anna's home, so he's naturally left feeling like a bundle of nerves and anxiety.

Episodes.Title: Yamada and Me
Episodes.Description: Valentine's Day is a week away, and Kyotaro finds himself roped into making chocolates with Anna and her friends. But complications arise when Moeko claims Kyotaro as her bae.

Episodes.Title: Yamada Likes…
Episodes.Description: Valentine's Day chocolates hold a special meaning, and Anna wants to know what they mean to Kyotaro.

Episodes.Title: I Want to Know
Episodes.Description: Despite all the time Kyotaro has spent with Anna, he discovers that there is so much more he doesn't know about her. More importantly, he realizes he wants to change that.

Episodes.Title: Yamada Likes Me
Episodes.Description: As the student rep, Kyotaro faces the unenviable task of delivering the graduation speech. Now he'll need a dose of confidence and a little help from Anna to pull it off.

Episodes.Title: We're Overflowing
Episodes.Description: The implications and meanings of Anna's indirect confession leave Kyotaro reeling. He may not know what will happen next, but he knows he cannot afford to mess this up.

Episodes.Title: We Stayed Up All Night
Episodes.Description: The school year is ending. With a window of opportunity closing, Kyotaro reaches a decision: if he can make this shot in a basketball game against Anna, he’ll ask her out.

Episodes.Title: We Made a Promise
Episodes.Description: Kyotaro discovers an obsessed fan is spreading rumors online that Anna has a boyfriend. Knowing what that means for both her safety and career, he cannot help but worry.

Episodes.Title: I Want to Be Closer to Yamada
Episodes.Description: A new school year means a new class and new friends. Unfortunately, it also means new challenges to Kyotaro and Anna's evolving situationship.

Episodes.Title: I Don't Want to Lose
Episodes.Description: Kyotaro wants nothing to do with the sports festival this year, but all that changes when Sho challenges him to a one-on-one in the cavalry battle.

Episodes.Title: I Want to Tell Her
Episodes.Description: The class is excited for the upcoming school trip, except for Anna, who is no longer acting like herself. Kyotaro wonders what it means, not realizing that she made a choice.

Episodes.Title: I, We, Fell in Love
Episodes.Description: Anna and Kyotaro's bond is teetering between friendship and romance. Perhaps this time the scales will tip and Kyotaro can finally tell Anna the words she wishes to hear.
